ok I’m pissed and I need to put this somewhere.

a friend sent me a listing tonight from a sticker shop called StickerBurrow Co. they’re selling something called “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” for $6.50, or 3 for $15. it is my switchblade moth. the one I drew for the sept 13 flash day and posted on my sheet aug 30. the one somebody got tattooed in the first hour.

and I don’t mean it’s kind of similar or it has the same vibe. same little crack in the blade. same wing pattern. same linework. they didn’t even flip it. it’s not “inspired by” my drawing, it’s a straight scan of my drawing that they slapped on a sticker.

I messaged them and asked them to take it down. told them I have the original drawing and the dated post. their response was basically “love your work!” followed by “moths are a very common tattoo motif” and then they told me to send a registered copyright through their support form. have a great day!! lol.

yes. moths are common. switchblades are common. you know what isn’t some generic motif floating around for anybody to grab? the exact lines I drew at my kitchen table, including the crack I put in the blade. come on.

the part that really got me is that the client wearing this tattoo messaged me tonight. somebody showed her the sticker and she thought I was the one selling them. she thought I had taken the piece she trusted me with and turned it into merch.

I’m not putting her name or anything else about her on here, but you know who you are: I did not sell your tattoo. I did not make those stickers, I did not license that design, and I did not give anybody permission to print it. I am so sorry you even had to wonder.

my flash gets sold ONE time to ONE person. that is the whole deal. that’s what the client paid for. somebody chooses it, sits for it, and then walks around with it on their actual body. some company doesn’t get to scrape it off the internet and sell copies for six bucks because “moths are trending.”

this stuff makes me so tired because small shops and independent artists do not have lawyer money sitting around, and these places know it. they know most of us can’t spend months and thousands of dollars fighting over a drawing, so they hit you with a support form and keep making money off it in the meantime.

so if you have a minute, please go report StickerBurrow Co’s “Knife Moth Vinyl Decal” listing for copied/stolen artwork. and please don’t buy from them. if you already bought one without knowing where it came from, I’m not mad at you. you didn’t steal it.

I’m not tagging the shop page in this because this is personal. that’s my drawing, my client’s tattoo, and my name attached to something I would never do. rant over. still pissed though.
